INTRO_KR: The HKSAR Government established the Hong Kong Council for Testing and Certification (HKCTC) in September 2009 to advise it on the overall development strategy of the testing and certification industry. HKCTC has been adopting a market-oriented approach to promote the development of the industry. To reinforce the branding of "Tested in Hong Kong, Certified in Hong Kong", HKCTC promotes Hong Kong's testing and certification services through different channels, including participation in major trade fairs locally and overseas, organising seminars in Hong Kong, and placing interviews and articles in the media. Hong Kong Accreditation Service (HKAS) provides accreditation for laboratories, certification bodies and inspection bodies located in Hong Kong, through the Hong Kong Laboratory Accreditation Scheme (HOKLAS), Hong Kong Certification Body Accreditation Scheme (HKCAS) and Hong Kong Inspection Body Accreditation Scheme (HKIAS) respectively. HOKLAS was launched in 1985; HKCAS was launched in 1998 while HKIAS was launched in 1999.

INTRO_KR: Wready Clothing Limited was founded in 2022 with the goal of creating innovative women's garments. The company received HK$120,000 in startup funding from the PolyU Micro Fund in the same year. This investment allowed WREADY to develop its first collection of tops and dresses featuring built-in bra pads. Wready's products were initially sold online through their website and the Pinkoi platform. The brand's focus on comfort and confidence quickly earned positive feedback from customers. In the second year, Wready joined the CLA, Taiwan's leading fashion platform, and participated in the CENTERSTAGE event. Most recently, Wready made its international debut at Milan Fashion Week 2024, solidifying its position as an innovator in women's apparel. The brand's seamless integration of function and fashion has captured the attention of both consumers and industry experts. WREADY is looking for expansion internationally and open for discussion of collaboration.
